body:
I think the sibling behaviour in that case is actually correct, since you are matching on the rest of the sentence, including that closing parenthesis. I think (Mode**lExample)** looks more "pay attention from here onwards", while (Mode**lExample**) looks like "pay only attention to 'lExample'", which will be odd if there's other highlighted text after this word.

Google's autocomplete seems to try following a sibling behaviour, although it often sees separators as typos and won't highlight the match
